X,22. tùm Roman. XIV, 5. 1. Thess. 1,5. VIII. De firmitate, ac constantiâ

page.notes: Greek passages are transcribed from a small, blurred scan and are uncertain. The line "κατὰ τὸν αὐτὸν τρό-" and the following "τὸν τῆς παιδείας" are the least certain. The section numerals, which appear as I., II. and so on, are read from the scan. The running head's final letter and the catchword "tiâ" are partly obscured.
